SCRIPT.KOREAN: 저는 동 과장님이랑 얘기 좀 하러 먼저 내려갈게요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m going to head downstairs to talk with Manager Dong first.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我先下去和佟科长谈点事情
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我下樓去跟佟課長聊一下
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺、トン課長と話しがあるんで先に行ってます
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku mau turun dulu, ngobrol sama Manajer Dong.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Vou descer primeiro pra falar com minha chefe.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Voy a bajar primero a hablar con mi jefa.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من به طبقه پایین می روم تا ابتدا با مدیر دونگ صحبت کنم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You guys go ahead without me.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你們就不用管我了，自己吃吧
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺抜きで食べててください
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما بچه ها بدون من پیش بروید.

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊～ 你這樣說好讓人難過喔！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ〜もう、つれないですね！
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه ~ این خیلی ناامید کننده است!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그럼 내일 저녁은 꼭 시간 내줘요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Then make sure you free up time for tomorrow evening.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那明天晚上一定要空出时间给我
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那... 明天晚上一定要把時間空下來喔
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあ明日の夜は時間くださいね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau gitu, pastiin kamu luangin waktu buat besok malam, ya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então me promete que amanhã à noite vai arrumar um tempinho.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Entonces prométeme que mañana en la noche sí sacas tiempo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سپس مطمئن شوید که برای فردا عصر وقت آزاد کرده اید.
